side.importTitle: Import a Postman collection and environment
side.noCollections: No collections yet. Import one from Postman or create one with ＋.

req.urlPlaceholder: Type the URL. Use {{variable}} for environment values.
req.bulkHint: One per line, "Key: Value". Start with // to disable it.
req.varMissing: {name} is not defined in the environment, the collection or the globals

auth.inheritsNothing: No parent defines auth: the request is sent without authentication.
auth.callbackHint: RunPost listens on this address of your computer during the sign-in: register it with the provider.
auth.digestHint: RunPost sends the request, answers the server's challenge and signs the retry.
auth.noToken: No access token yet: get one to sign in.
auth.noTokenCc: No token yet: RunPost requests one when you send.
auth.waiting: Complete the sign-in in your browser…

body.pathHint: In the browser, type the full path of the file.

scripts.note: They run when sending and in the Runner: Pre-request before variables are resolved, Tests with the response. pm.* API like Postman; no require or CryptoJS (use runpost.crypto).

reqSettings.tlsWarning: Without TLS verification anyone on the network can impersonate the server.

res.empty: Send the request to see the response.
res.noTests: This request has no tests. Write them in Scripts → Tests with pm.test(…).
res.binary: Binary response ({size}). Use Save to open it with another program.
res.name: Name
res.previewText: Preview is for HTML only. This body is shown as text.
res.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
res.skipped: Request skipped by a script (pm.execution.skipRequest()): nothing was sent.

errors.historyHint: It was recorded in the history.

drawer.consoleEmpty: Every send will show up here: the resolved URL, the real headers (secrets as ***) and network errors.
drawer.agentEmpty: Agent MCP calls show up here once you connect it over HTTP with the app open.
drawer.runnerEmpty: Pick a collection or folder and press Run. Also: right-click in the tree → Run.

env.name: Environment name
env.globalsHint: Globals apply with any environment. If the active environment has a variable with the same name, the environment wins.
env.hint: Type in the last row to add a variable. A secret shows as *** in the app, in the history and to the agent.
env.sideHint: ● / ○ activates the environment. Click its name to edit its variables.
env.deleteBody: The environment and its file in the workspace will be deleted.
env.moveAllTitle: Take the secret values out of the environment file and store them in the system keyring
env.moveOneTitle: Take the value out of the environment file and store it in the system keyring (Credential Manager, Keychain or Secret Service)
env.inKeyringTitle: In the system keyring: the environment file does not store the value
env.moved: "{name}" is now in the system keyring.
env.movedMany: {count} secrets moved to the system keyring.

history.openHint: Click to open it in a tab
history.clearBody: Every history entry will be deleted. Collections and environments are not touched.
history.masked: History stores secrets as ***. Put back the value or its {{variable}} before sending.

docs.hint: Basic markdown: headings, bold, italic, code, lists, quotes and links.
docs.empty: No documentation yet. Click Edit to write it.
docs.requestHint: What this request does and how to use it. Saved with the request, in markdown.

export.title: Export «{name}» for Postman
export.stripOn: Values marked as secret are exported empty. Safe to share.
export.stripOff: The file will carry the secrets in plain text. Use it only for your own copy.

curl.copied: curl copied. Secrets stay as {{variable}}, without their value.
curl.copyManually: Could not use the clipboard. Copy the command:

runner.chooseDataHint: CSV or JSON file: one iteration per row (pm.iterationData)
runner.noCollections: Import or create a collection to run it here.

empty.importHint: Postman, OpenAPI, HAR, Insomnia, Bruno or a cURL command.
empty.agentHint: Copy the MCP configuration for Claude Code, Codex or Claude Desktop.
empty.footer: Everything is saved in {path} as JSON files. No account. No cloud.

agent.missingExe: Heads up: {exe} does not exist yet. Build it first with scripts\build.bat.
agent.copyManually: The clipboard is not available. Copy this text and paste it into {target}.
agent.off: MCP over HTTP is off (settings.json → mcp.http_port)
agent.seeAll: See all in the Agent panel
agent.drawerEmptyAt: Agent calls will show up here. Connect it to {url} with "Connect agent" in the Agent panel.
agent.liveAt: With the app open, every call to {url} shows up here live, and protected ones ask for your permission.
agent.wants: {client} wants to run a protected request
agent.wantsMany: {client} wants to run {count} protected requests from {collection}
agent.openHint: Click: open the request in a tab
agent.exportTitle: Copy the meter (per call and total) as Markdown for docs/BENCH.md
agent.meterCopied: Meter copied as Markdown: paste it into docs/BENCH.md.
agent.meterManual: The clipboard is not available. Copy this table and paste it into docs/BENCH.md.
agent.expired: Nobody answered in 60 s: {client} got error: policy for "{request}".
agent.cancelled: {client} stopped waiting for the approval of "{request}".
agent.gone: That request was no longer pending (it expired or was already decided).
agent.noRequest: This call is not about a saved request.
agent.stdioNote: Claude Desktop connects over stdio: while RunPost is open on this workspace, its calls show up here too.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.deleteCollection: The collection and its workspace file will be deleted.
dialog.deleteFolder: The folder and everything inside it will be deleted.
dialog.deleteRequest: The request will be removed from the collection.
dialog.unsavedBody: "{name}" has unsaved changes. Save them before closing?

import.title: Import
import.pasteLabel: Paste a cURL command or the content of a collection
import.pastePlaceholder:
curl https://api.example.com/v1/items -H 'Accept: application/json'

…or a Postman, OpenAPI (JSON/YAML), HAR, Insomnia or Bruno export.
import.formats: Postman v2.1 (collections and environments) · OpenAPI 3 (JSON or YAML) · HAR · Insomnia (v4 and v5) · Bruno (.bru, YAML or JSON) · cURL.
import.brunoHint: A Bruno collection stored in a folder: choose its bruno.json or opencollection.yml file.
import.brunoHintBrowser: Bruno: export the collection to a single file, JSON or YAML (folders need the desktop app).
import.curlOpened: cURL opened in a new tab. Save it to keep it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.tlsWarning: With verification off, anyone on the network can impersonate the server.
settings.openBrowser: In browser mode, open it from your file explorer.
settings.maskInfo: Always on: the agent never sees secrets.

common.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard: {text}

policy.title: Agent · {name}
policy.intro: Rules for the calls an agent makes to this collection over MCP. From the app you can send any request.
policy.allowedHint: All checked means no restriction. Anything unchecked is rejected with error: policy.
policy.approvalHint: With the app open and the agent connected over HTTP you get a prompt to Approve or Deny; the agent waits up to 60 s.
policy.limitHint: Empty = no limit. Above it, the agent gets error: policy with how many seconds to wait.
policy.stdioNote: Over stdio (app closed) anything that needs approval is rejected: the agent gets error: policy and asks you.

about.tagline: Local HTTP client with an MCP server for agents. One binary, no account, no telemetry.

code.title: Code snippet
code.copied: Snippet copied. Secrets stay as {{variable}}, without their value.
code.copyFailed: Could not use the clipboard: select the code and copy it.
code.note: Plain variables are replaced; secrets stay as {{variable}}.

cookies.title: Manage cookies
cookies.hint: Cookies the app received, or that you add here. They go with the requests to their domain and live in memory while the app is open: they are not saved in the workspace.

certs.title: Client certificates
certs.hint: For APIs with mutual TLS. The certificate and its key are PEM files (the key unencrypted) and go only to the matching host. To convert a PFX file: openssl pkcs12 -in client.pfx -out client.pem -nodes
